description: This PHP source file defines a class 'PDFView' within the SuiteCRM system, responsible for rendering the PDF settings in the administration module. It inherits from an abstract view class and uses Smarty templates for display logic, as well as external classes for PDF control and engine selection.

classes.name: PDFView
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering the PDF configuration interface for the SuiteCRM administration module. It sets up template variables and handles display logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view by calling the parent constructor with a specific template file.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares data for display by assigning variables related to PDF controller and engine to the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering of the Smarty template, choosing between default and custom templates if available.
